english.note: Use this in a narrative turn meaning that events unexpectedly turned out differently from what was just expected.
Use this before an unexpected or disappointing result corresponding to English “only to.”

examples.english: I thought the bus still had seats, but unexpectedly it was full as soon as I got on.
examples.traditional: 我以為架巴士仲有位，點知一上車就滿座。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 ji5 wai4 gaa3 baa1 si2 zung6 jau5 wai2 dim2 zi1 jat1 soeng5 ce1 zau6 mun5 zo6

examples.english: I left home early on purpose, only to get stuck in traffic anyway.
examples.traditional: 我特登早啲出門口，點知仲係塞車。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dak6 dang1 zou2 di1 ceot1 mun4 hau2 dim2 zi1 zung6 hai6 sak1 ce1
